remarks: BRAND NEW Construction by Cypress Development in Prime New Canaan Location offering a new detached townhouse. Experience luxury living in this beautifully designed 3-bedroom townhouse, just a short stroll from downtown New Canaan. This new construction showcases an impressive open floor plan, with 9' ceilings and a seamless flow throughout the main living spaces. The gourmet kitchen, equipped with custom cabinets, granite countertops, and high-end appliances is perfectly integrated with the dining area, making it ideal for both casual meals and formal gatherings. The open living room offers a cozy retreat, featuring a modern fireplace that adds warmth and ambiance to the space. On the upper level, the Primary Suite offers a large walk-in closet and a luxurious spa-like bath with soaking tub, providing a serene space to unwind. Two additional bedrooms, two full baths, and a laundry room complete this floor. The fully finished third floor offers a versatile space, perfect for a media room or home office, while the fully finished lower level provides even more living options, with a recreation room and glassed-in gym. Expansive sliding doors lead to a private patio and green space, offering a peaceful outdoor area. Additional features include an attached 2-car garage. This townhouse is a perfect blend of luxury and functionality, offering spacious living in an unbeatable location.
